subcodes.title: Words spoken on 1911-Nov-28 in Paris
subcodes.first_line: In these gatherings where we have met and spoken together you have all become acquainted with the principles of this dispensation, and with the reality of facts. Unto you it has been given to know these things
subcodes.first_line_orig: موسیو در یفوس امروز صدایش گرفته نمیتواند
full_text_parts: 15 Rue Greuze, Paris, December 1st When I arrived in Paris some time ago for the first time, I looked around me with much interest, and in my mind I likened this beautiful city to a large garden. With loving care and much thought I examined the soil, and found it to be very good and full of possibility for steadfast faith and firm belief, for a seed of God's love has been cast into the ground.
